Market today: The market's mood is driven by continued enthusiasm for AI infrastructure, with big players like Nvidia and Goldman Sachs signaling strong investment. This directly fuels your tech and chip-heavy portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-43.05%) and SPAL (-39.68%) are deep in drawdown. As leveraged ETFs, they decay and amplify losses, especially on margin. SPAL is also a brand-new, very volatile IPO.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader chip sector's performance and any further news on AI infrastructure spending. Monitor your leveraged positions for any signs of further weakness.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged positions and stay highly responsive to chip sector momentum.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or adjusting your stop loss from the default 200.00 given the -43.05% drawdown and leveraged decay.
SPAL: Review your stop loss at 21.38. This is a new, leveraged ETF, and its -39.68% loss on margin demands immediate attention.
No new buys today - hold and watch. While the scanner has setups, no headline provides a strong enough catalyst for a new tech/chip buy right now.
